liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Reviewer's personal favorite of the night is the Dew, which followed an inspired Other One; Reviewer hears powerful Garcia solos and gradual dynamic and emotional shifts in Morning Dew [10][15][18]
- **He's Gone** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises solid, expressive vocals on He's Gone; Reviewer loves the He's Gone into Truckin' combination as a particularly tasty stretch [15][20]
- **Candyman** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed the Cumberland Blues and the Candyman [16]
- **Cumberland Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry shreds Cumberland Blues [12]
- **Althea** (1 review): Reviewer calls Althea sweet, with Jerry's voice sounding great [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Happy Birthday Mickey**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd81-09-11.wise.munder.7090.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 176 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience tape's sound needs to be cleaner and hopes a better source exists; Reviewer finds the sound weak, with little bass and Phil inaudible in parts [9][15]
- **gd1981-09-11.148624.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1981-09-11.nak700.anon-poris-severson.LMPP.95290.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer wishes this source were crisper, noting Walker and Wise audience tapes suffer from clapping near the mics [20]
- **gd1981-09-11.fob.nak300.walker.scotton.miller.95743.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 180 min; rated 4.12/5 by 8 [5]
- **gd1981-09-11.nak300.unknown.31791.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 24 songs; 176 min; rated 2.67/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: The Nak300 source has far more low end than the Wise tape, with no audible hiss and unobtrusive crowd; Reviewer calls the sound loud, clear and balanced, with Jerry especially prominent [16][17]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says security was extra tight on tapers at these Berkeley shows [9]
- Reviewer stood about twenty feet in front of Jerry; nearby park had speakers carrying a live feed for those outside [11]
- Sun set over the bay with sailboats visible from the top of the amphitheatre; fireworks went off over downtown San Francisco [14]
- Taper stood front-of-board for all three nights, running a single deck, during the no-taping era [17]
- The taper spent most of the weekend waiting in line to reach the best-sounding spot inside [4]
- Reviewer nominates this campus run, among the 1981 college shows, as a good candidate for an archive release [9]
- Reviewer ranks this opening night of a three-show run among the best three-show runs of the eighties [10]
- Reviewer says the second and third nights brought no miracle compared with the first [11]
- Reviewer says the next night is a blowout, and ranks this show among favorite 1981 shows [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd81-09-11.wise.munder.7090.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jim Wise; source: Audience Recording: Sennheiser 421's [1]. Also: Taped by Jim Wise with Sennheiser 421 mics into a Sony TC-D5; passed via Nic Brokenleg and Kevin Gills; Disc three was tracked at 80 minutes; converted with EAC to SHN by Willy [1]
- **gd1981-09-11.148624.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; 3 x Nakamichi 700 mics (cardioid left & right - X pattern; 80 degree angle; 6db bass EQ, omni center pointed… [2]. Also: A Bob Wagner and Charlie Miller Nak700 source supplies an 11-second patch in Drums [2]
- **gd1981-09-11.nak700.anon-poris-severson.LMPP.95290.flac16**: taped by anonymous taper, Jamie Poris, Mark Severson; transferred by Brian Green and  Evan K.; source: 3 Nakamich 700's (left and right Cardiod at 100 Deg, center omni 45 deg up) 45 feet from stage, dead center > Hand made 3 mic mixer > Sony D5 > MAC (dolby B) [4]
- **gd1981-09-11.fob.nak300.walker.scotton.miller.95743.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Nakamichi 300/CP1 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII) [5]
- **gd1981-09-11.nak300.unknown.31791.sbeok.flac16**: source: 2 nak 300 mics>Sony TC-5m(Dolby B)>MAC [8]
